To obtain the Divine Art fighting style, you must first gather resources to craft a flying ship. After that, you need to talk to an NPC and pay him 2000 Fragments. You must pay this amount 5 times.
Then, you need at least 5 players (or more) on the flying ship. You must fly above the clouds, where there are 7 danger stages. These stages include things like a sea with all sea beasts, but they appear in the clouds in a different and slightly stronger form.
If you pay the NPC 2000 Fragments again and reach Danger Level 7, a castle and a big gate will spawn. There will be a white orb, and when you interact with it, a Hydra Dragon with 3 heads will spawn.
The fight works like a Hydra:
You must defeat 2 heads first so only one remains
The Hydra has 1 million HP
After defeating it, a heart will drop. You must carry the heart using your ship and take it to Danger Level 0. Then you will receive a special heart item.
Requirements to craft Divine Art:
Money: 10M
Fragments: 10K
Resources:
White Fragment
Hydra Wings
Divine Shark Teeth

Blox Fruits Concept: Sea 4, Sword Fusion, and Rubber ReworkHello developers! I have a few major suggestions that would make the game much more exciting for the community in future updates:Sword Upgrades (V2 / V3) in Sea 4: Please add an option to upgrade our swords to V2 and V3 versions in the 4th Sea, just like races or fighting styles. This would bring new designs, better visual effects, and buffed skills to older weapons.Sword Fusion Mechanic: Introduce a system where players can combine two different swords into a single dual-weapon. This fusion mechanic would greatly increase build diversity and make trading much more active.Don't let our hard work go to waste: It takes an enormous amount of time, countless hours of grinding, and insane effort for players to finally obtain endgame swords like CDK (Cursed Dual Katana) and TTK (True Triple Katana). It feels really heartbreaking when these legendary weapons become useless or weak in new seas. Please don't let our painful grind be in vain — let us upgrade and power them up further so they stay relevant!Rubber Fruit Rework (Rubber V2 / V3): Since Blox Fruits is based on One Piece, Luffy's signature fruit feels way too weak in the current meta. It desperately needs a complete rework or a V2/V3 awakening. The main protagonist's fruit should be one of the most powerful and fun fruits to play with.Thank you for your hard work, I hope you consider these ideas

Hey Uzoth, can I ask you why the Dough V1 graphics are so bad? Dough V1 really feels like an "ancient relic" compared to the visual effects of newer fruits or its Awakening version (V2).
​The main problem with Dough V1 is its shape, which is just stiff white circles. In the anime, Katakuri's power is liquid and sticky, yet solid at the same time. If I were the admin or owner, here is what I would change about the Dough V1 visuals:
​Dough V1 Visual Rework
​Textures & Particles: Change those "white tennis ball" models into a glossier and more elastic texture. When a skill is used, there should be dough or flour particles scattered on the ground to make it feel like actual pastry dough.
​Sticky Dough Skill Animation: Currently, it just pulls enemies normally. I would add an animation where the user's hand actually transforms into stretching dough that wraps around the enemy with a much smoother visual effect.
​Restless Dough Barrage Skill: This one needs a glow-up the most. Instead of just stiff hands appearing from above, it would be cooler to have small dough portals appearing, and the hits should have an impact effect like screen shake.
​Why is This Important?
​So that the transition from V1 to V2 doesn't feel like you're "switching games." Right now, using V1 feels like playing a game from 2019, but once you awaken it, it jumps straight to 2026. The difference is too jarring.

Revisiting the Spin Fruit (Guru Guru no Mi) in Blox Fruits presents an opportunity to turn it from a starter fruit into a "low-cost, high-skill" utility tool. Based on its current reputation as a weak, low-damage fruit, here are several ideas to rework it:

1. Passive Abilities & Movement

Passive: Gyroscopic Balance: The user takes 10% less damage from knockback moves and has improved air control, making them harder to combo in the air.

Passive: Propeller Levitation: Jumping in the air activates a propeller on the head, allowing for gliding or slow descent, similar to a weaker version of the Kitsune speed boost, to aid in early-game exploration.

2. Revamped Move Set (Reworked Abilities)

[Z] Razor Wind (Enhanced): Instead of just straight wind slashes, this move could act as a 360-degree deflection shield for 1 second, pushing back enemies and projectiles.

[X] Tornado Assault (Mobility + Damage): Transform the tornado into a fast-moving, controllable dash that damages all enemies in its path, ending with a slight upward knockup to start a combo.

[C] Air Slasher (Vacuum Effect): Instead of just a slash, this move creates a miniature tornado that sucks nearby enemies towards the center, allowing the user to set up a follow-up melee combo.

[F] Helicopter Flight (Flight + Utility): Drastically increase the speed of the flight to make it a viable alternative to Light for traveling. While flying, it could automatically deflect small incoming projectiles.

3. Awakening Concepts

Awakening: Hurricane/Typhoon:

Move: Typhoon Eye: Creates a massive, permanent (for 10 seconds) typhoon on the field that traps players, breaks Instinct, and deals damage over time.

Move: Propeller Master: Allows the user to fly at extremely high speeds, with the flight acting as a damage-dealing move.

4. Gameplay Philosophy

Focus on Combo Utility: Rather than making Spin high damage, make it a "setup" fruit. Its moves should have low cooldowns and high knockback/stun, allowing for creative combos with swords or fighting styles.

Instinct Break Focus: Ensure all moves, especially after a potential awakening, break Observation Haki (Instinct) to make it useful in PvP.

These changes would move Spin from a "Trash Tier" fruit to a competitive, fun-to-use option for both early-game farming and niche PvP situations.

A great concept for a "good for everything" fruit is the Mythical Golem Fruit (or Stone Fruit). This idea is a community favorite because it combines the best features of Awakened Buddha, Magma, and Dough into one versatile power.

Mythical Golem Fruit Concept

Transformation (V - Golem Beast): Transforms the user into a massive stone giant, granting a 50% damage reduction and an insane reach boost for swords and fighting styles.

Passive Ability (Stone Surface): Like Awakened Magma, the user can walk on water, which is essential for Sea Beast hunting.

Moveset for Grinding & PvP:

[Z] Stone Gauntlet: A heavy lunging punch that breaks an opponent's "Instinct" (Ken Haki), making it lethal in PvP combos.

[X] Stone Blast: Pulls rocks from the ground and hurls them, creating a large explosion (AoE) that hits groups of NPCs for fast grinding.

[C] Colossal Spikes: Summons massive stone spikes over a huge area to stun enemies and deal continuous damage.

[F] Rolling Boulder (Mobility): Turns the user into a high-speed boulder that can travel across islands and damage anyone it rolls over.

Why this is the "Best" Concept

Efficiency: The transformation makes level grinding as easy as using Buddha.

Sea Events: Water walking and high-damage AoE moves allow you to solo Sea Beasts and Rumbling Waters.

PvP Dominance: Stuns and instinct-breaking moves give you a clear advantage against fast Kitsune or Leopard users.

I was playing normally when the fruit visuals appeared, leading me to believe that this is most likely a rendering or data loading glitch rather than intentional content. The reappearance of a deleted fruit may indicate that older files were unintentionally reactivated, while the new fruit model could point to unreleased content being accidentally exposed in the live version.
This bug could potentially lead to player confusion, misinformation, or gameplay imbalance if other players begin to find or interact with assets not meant for public access. Since fruits are a core part of Blox Fruits gameplay, any inconsistency in their availability or display can affect player experience significantly.
I am reporting this issue to help maintain the game’s stability and accuracy for all players. The attached images show the fruits clearly and should help the development team investigate where the assets are coming from. I hope this report assists in identifying the problem and preventing further disruption.
Overall, the game remains enjoyable, but resolving this bug will ensure smoother gameplay and protect the integrity of future updates. I appreciate the developers’ hard work and hope the information I provided is useful in correcting the issue.

I hope this report assists in identifying the problem and preventing further disruption.

My Theory for Blox Fruits Update 28: Ice, Fire, and Shadow Reworks
​This entire update made me come up with a theory about all of it. I imagined a new trailer, and I'll share what that trailer would look like in my imagination:
​Trailer 1
​The trailer would start with the Yeti arriving at several ice islands, such as the Frozen Village in Sea 1, the Snow Mountain in Sea 2, etc., and noticing that all these islands are now defrosted, as if something had passed through.
​Right after this, the scene would switch to the Hot and Cold Island, where the Leopard (fruit user) would be aggressively melting the island. Then, something would emerge from the darkness to stop the Leopard from doing this, starting a battle between the two: Leopard Rework vs. Shadow Rework.
​This fight would begin in the morning and end in the afternoon, with the Leopard winning the battle. Right after, a creature made of lava would appear behind the Leopard, and the trailer would end, cutting to the Leopard Rework and Shadow Rework Showcase.
​Trailer 2
​After the Leopard defeats the Shadow, the creature made of lava appears behind him: it's the ONI, a lava version of the Yeti modified by the Scientist.
​The battle begins, moving from the cold side of the island to the hot side, making the two fight fiercely. While the Leopard and the Oni are fighting, the darkness of night begins to creep in, which causes the Shadow user to achieve their Awakening, thus interfering in the Leopard vs. Oni fight.
​This interference would send both the Leopard and the Oni flying to opposite sides, leaving the Shadow user in the middle of them. Then, the Leopard and the Oni would rush toward the Shadow, causing the trailer to end and cut to the Oni Showcase and Shadow Awakening Showcase.
​In conclusion, I believe this update will bring the rework for the Leopard and Shadow fruits, and a new skin/boss for the Yeti (the Oni).
​I hope you liked my theory. Bye-bye! 👋

​Trailer 1

​This fight would begin in the morning and end in the afternoon, with the Leopard winning the battle. Right after, a creature made of lava would appear behind the Leopard, and the trailer would end, cutting to the Leopard Rework and Shadow Rework Showcase.
​Trailer 2
​After the Leopard defeats the Shadow, the creature made of lava appears behind him: it's the ONI, a lava version of the Yeti modified by the Scientist.
​The battle begins, moving from the cold side of the island to the hot side, making the two fight fiercely. While the Leopard and the Oni are fighting, the darkness of night begins to creep in, which causes the Shadow user to achieve their Awakening, thus interfering in the Leopard vs. Oni fight.

It's tiring enough to deal with toddlers who expect and pressure other people to being a literal sweat at the game. I just wanna get more stuff in the game to get better fruits for more destruction, and to help new players out. not to mention dragon WAS great for teamers. but now? you get fried man. THIS IS the same fruit the community was HYPED for, the same fruit people literally Were RAIDING THE DISCORD SERVER FOR. RAVING for it, but now? they all turned their backs and want it shot dead. DON'T even bring out the excuse that you move out of the safezone only to be shredded and that its annoying. Have more transformation time than THAT. people were complaining about dragon far too much, when we literally had many options to fight against them. OR you could just air camp like they do and fight em off! that being said here are a couple and a BRIEF explanation as to how they counter them.

PORTAL - Most portal mains [if used right] could always cheese dragons with their combos, stuns, I think it had I frames before with one of its moves. and mobility. it always had counters against pretty much EVERY fruit in the game, and at a fair rate as well.

BUDDHA - self explanatory, This is like the default option for mauling any beast fruit at the moment.

MAMMOTH - very tanky with the right build, high damage, good aoe. You genuinely cannot die to a dragon before and after the nerfs if you played carefully, It's genuinely a goated fruit to be honest.

GRAVITY - situational but, with the right build it just straightup recreates the dinosaur extinction, The cutscene move is costly but worth it. it can infinitely air stall and is just A genuinely great fruit.

BLIZZARD - literally the most annoying thing for dragon users, its got good DPS, everything about it just screams DRAGON COUNTER. and it's pretty darn spammable to.

T REX- Similar To blizzard, although more situational. You literally will start to go RABID on dragon users with the transformation, and then next thing you know they are ATLEAST half hp. or NOW with the new nerfs, literally just on life support without transformation anymore. you CANNOT even run from a T rex or else you get punished even MORE. the only weakness is that It doesn't really have many options to go in the air. Or it can be quite situational at times honestly.

RUMBLE - high aoe, good stun, can keep the dragons at bay sometimes. not to mention its rework is coming so everything GOOD about it that it's able to do against dragons right now may just improve by TEN THOUSAND-FOLD honestly. Similar to buddha [or portal] it's like a default option.

KITSUNE - talking from self experience, I was just too fast. kitsune's damage is great, and its just too fast. You can infinitely stall a Dragon if you play right, especially if its east. the air is your friend at this point just liked dragons. and similar to T rex, you can go HAM on them. Not much you even have to say about it

GAS - this one is literally just everything annoying about blizzard or T rex if you blended it together and turned it into a genie. And with the buffs now here? It's practically DONEZO if you face a dragon as a gas most of the time. Or atleast it's a 50/50, maybe 60/40.

Day 1 of sharing a Blox fruits update idea:
I just wanted to share an idea I’ve had for a while now. I used to play Blox Fruits a lot, but lately it’s felt kinda stale—especially after hitting max level. Once you get there, there’s not much left to do besides PvP or grinding for new fruits. It gets repetitive fast.

So I was thinking… what if Blox Fruits became more of a story-based RPG? I know it’s a pretty common idea, but I feel like it could actually work really well for the game. Imagine having a main storyline with quests that unlock as you level up—kind of like a real adventure.

Here’s what I’m imagining:
	•	Main Quests – Follow the main storyline
	•	Character Quests – Learn about different characters, their backstories, maybe build friendships with them
	•	Side Quests – Extra stories outside of the main plot
	•	Explore Quests – Discovering new areas, hidden islands, etc.
	•	Missions – The basic grindy quests we already have
	•	Event Quests – Special limited-time quests during events

To support all this, maybe leveling could be made a bit easier, islands could be bigger and more explorable, and players doing quests could get PvP immunity so they don’t get interrupted constantly.

It also opens the door for smaller weekly updates—new quests, storylines, character arcs—without having to wait for a massive update every time. Could keep the game feeling fresh, even for max-level players.

I know it’s a super long shot that anything like this gets added, but just wanted to share the idea in case it sparks something. Thanks for reading either way! And if you like my idea then send a reply. I have much more on my mind.

Control Rework Concepts
The Control fruit in Blox Fruits is often discussed for potential reworks, with several fan concepts aiming to improve its gameplay and balance. Here’s a summary of notable ideas:
 
Visual Revamp and Move Adjustments
 
- Base Form:
- Visual overhaul with reduced startup, end lag, and knockback for all moves .
- X move becomes an M1, C move (Echo Knife) becomes the X move, and a new C move is added .
- New C Move:
- Storm Tip Lance: Jumps into the air with a blue spear. Holding charges it, increasing range, damage (2,800–5,500), and hitbox .
- New F Move:
- Instant Thrust: Teleports behind enemies, electrocutes them, and pins them down for 0.5 seconds .
 
Awakening Mechanics
 
- Mastery Requirement:
- Requires 400 Mastery to start a quest. Players gather "hearts" by defeating NPCs/players in the Third Sea .
- Three hearts trade for a raid chip to fully awaken .
- Awakened Moves:
- Z: Eclipse Chamber – Room becomes darker, enemies regenerate 40% less health, and allies deal 5% more damage .
- F: Enigmatic Transmission – Invisible teleport with electric explosion (3,700 damage) if near enemies .
- X: Dagger of Resonance – Dragon F-speed dash, energy slashes, and final explosion .
- C: Thunder Spear Tempest – Lightning spear electrocutes the entire room .
- M1: Planetary Devastation – Black orb pulls enemies and explodes .
- V: Ion Flare Overcharge – Drains enemy energy/health, room explodes .
- Passive:
- Electric Weakening – Enemies take 10% more damage from non-Control attacks after each Control hit .
 
Alternative Concepts
 
- Room-Bound Moves:
- Moves (except M1) only work within a customizable room. Room types include Hell’s Kitchen (burn damage), Frozen Ocean (slows opponents), and Endless Void (life leech) .
- Hazard Radiation:
- Moves create a radioactive aura dealing 660 damage per tick .
- Sword Integration:
- Koko swords gain 20% range/damage, and moves use higher stats between sword and fruit .
 
Balancing and Cooldown Suggestions
 
- Unawakened:
- F: 8 seconds
- C: 16 seconds .
- Awakened:
- F: 9 seconds
- X: 13 seconds
- C: 18 seconds
- M1: 7 seconds
- V: 20 seconds .
 
Trading Value
 
While Control is currently common, its potential rework could significantly increase its trading value .
 
Note: These are fan concepts, and the official rework (if implemented) may differ. The Blox Fruits developers have not confirmed any specific plans for Control .

Wave 2- Shandas(Lv. 2500, uses awk light M1 and Z)
Wave 3- Divine God(Lv. 3000, 150k HP, uses all moves of awk Light except X)

God's Cloak- Mythical, Gives 30% Defense against melee, sword, and guns. Increases damage on anything by 35%. +2000 HP +2000 energy, 20% life leech.
Talk to the NPC with no name. He will say "Excellent. But the Soul Reaper is attacking. You must undergo the final trial, and defeat his army"
You'll be teleported to an island like Hell Dimension. There will be 5 waves of enemies.
Wave 1- Reborn Skeletons (20 will spawn), (Lv. 2350, uses yama only M1)
Wave 2- Living Zombies (20 will spawn), ( Lv. 2450, uses yama M1 and Z)
Wave 3- Demonic Souls (25 will spawn), (Lv. 2550, uses Dark awk Z and yama M1)
Wave 4- Hell's Guards (30 will spawn), (Lv. 2600, uses Dark awk Z, and C, and Yama M1)
Wave 5- Soul Reaper (Lv. 3000, uses all moves of awk dark except X, and Hallow Scythe with both moves)
Soul Reaper drops- 5 Hell tokens, Devil's Helmet.
Devil's Helmet- Mythical, gives 30% Defense against all attacks, 30% more damage on all attacks, 50% life leech, +2000 HP, +2500 Energy.
After defeating Soul Reaper, you will be teleported back to haunted castle basement. The NPC will say "Excellent job! Here, take this essence, and find the secret room on this island. You will find the Divine Master, he will teach you the Divine Arts. "
You will get an item called "Heavenly Essence". It looks like Hallow Essence, but it's Golden, and it glows white.
Go to the place where Soul Reaper spawns. You will see a golden gate, with a pedestal in front of it(it will have a cup on top). Place the essence in the cup and a room will open.
Go inside and there will be the Divine Master NPC. 
Talk to him, he will say "Would you like to craft a Divine token? You need 5 Angel and Hell tokens." If you click craft, you will get the Divine token.
"Would you like to learn Divine Arts for 7.5M$, 10K fragments, a Divine token, and 50 Angel Wings? This fighting style allows you to manipulate extremely strong heavenly powers."
If you click "Learn", a message will say "materials used successfully", and you will get the fighting style.

The same goes with Unawakened Spider C where it's used as a finisher after Awakened Spider V but at the same time, Awakened Spider C can be used as a combo starter. 

IMO, Awakenings are good for the game to give players skill variations that they can play with which makes the players creative. Ayo I got a full falcon rework/Awakening in mind check it out

Z-Bronze wings
Gives the user sharp wings
Passive-increases jump height and makes you fall a bit slower, dashing in air is faster then normal

X-Tornado gush
There’s two variants, the tap variant and the hold variant,
Tap-Releases a quick gust of wind but deals little knock back
Hold-Sends out tornado that holds the enemy in place and stuns them for a little after the move
(The user flaps their wings quickly in the tap, they flap their wings repeatedly in the hold

C-Feather Explosion
You grab a bunch of feathers from your wings and squish them into a feather type basketball and throw them to the enemy, when the ball explodes on impact, it sends  a bunch of feathers flying everywhere causing extra aoe damage

F-Eagle Avaiation
It basically makes you fly but it’s faster then most flying fruits but it’s still only outmatched by light,
When flying and you fly into an enemy, you grab them with your falcon feet and smash them into a wall or the ground, depending on where you are aiming

V-Full Falcon
This is basically a transformation,
You turn into a falcon the size of 2 players, and there’s two variations of the transformation

Passive-you jump twice as high as you used to, so 10 sky jumps are equivalent to 20
It also takes 30% less damage than regular players

No haki- you look like a giant man bird with giant wings behind you and your hands are turned into falcon claws along with your feet

With haki-A giant man bird but your body is covered with golden armor, and your falcon face is obscured by a gold mask covering your beak, you also have shades on, your shoulders have spikes on them

M1-You use your clawed falcon arms and claw your enemies while keeping them back with the wind produced by the force of the attacks but just close enough to continue attacking, the fourth m1 smashes the enemy into the ground



Z-bronze wings(transformed)
You flap your gigantic wings so hard that it causes the wind around you to blast away, causing a lot of Aoe damage ,makes you jump twice as hight as normal

X-Tornado Gush(Transformed)
Tap-Your tornado has a little burn effect and it sends a short burst of fire wind to the enemy
Hold-Creates a giant fire tornado at the enemy for a long period of time, it deals burn damage after the enemy is un stunned

C-Feather explosion
Throws two giant fiery feather balls at the same time that deal some burn damage

F-Eagle Avaiation
Makes you fly really fast ,faster than most flight abilities besides light,
Whenever you fly into someone, similar to the dragon X move, you carry them with your claws and throw them to the nearest adoption center,

For the first stranger:

Grass is everywhere. From the sprawling plains of the savannahs to suburban front lawns, it quietly blankets our world. Yet, for something so ubiquitous, grass is often overlooked. This extensive exploration into the subject of grass—spanning its biology, ecological roles, cultural significance, and future potential—aims to honor its vital, often understated, role in sustaining life on Earth.

1. What is Grass?

Grass belongs to the Poaceae family, one of the largest plant families, encompassing over 10,000 species. This includes cereals like wheat, rice, and maize, as well as lawn grasses like Kentucky bluegrass and Bermuda grass. Grasses are monocots, which means they have a single embryonic leaf, and typically have hollow stems, narrow leaves, and small wind-pollinated flowers.

2. The Evolution of Grass

Grass first evolved around 66 million years ago, shortly before the extinction of the dinosaurs. Fossil evidence from dinosaur coprolites (fossilized feces) suggests that dinosaurs may have consumed early forms of grass. Over time, grasses spread across continents, becoming dominant in ecosystems such as prairies, steppes, and savannahs. The evolution of grazing animals, like bison and antelope, closely parallels the spread of grasslands.

3. Types of Grasslands

There are several types of grassland ecosystems:

Prairies: Found mainly in North America, prairies are rich in species and have deep, fertile soil.

Savannahs: Tropical grasslands with scattered trees, savannahs are home to large mammals like lions and elephants.

Steppes: These are temperate grasslands with a dry climate, found in Central Asia and parts of Eastern Europe.

Pampas: South American grasslands known for cattle ranching.

Veldt: Found in southern Africa, the veldt supports a wide range of wildlife.

4. The Anatomy of Grass

A typical grass plant consists of:

Culms: The hollow stems.

Leaves: Usually linear and narrow.

Nodes and Internodes: Nodes are points of leaf attachment, and internodes are stem segments between them.

Inflorescence: Flower arrangement, usually simple and wind-pollinated.

Roots: Fibrous and extensive, aiding in soil retention.

5. Grass and Agriculture

Cereal grasses form the backbone of global agriculture. Wheat, rice, corn, barley, and oats feed billions of people and livestock. These crops are staple foods in nearly every culture and are integral to food security. Rice alone feeds over half the world's population on a daily basis.

6. Grasses in Ecosystems

Grasslands support diverse communities of plants, animals, fungi, and microbes. They provide habitat for pollinators and nesting birds. Their deep root systems help sequester carbon, stabilize soil, and retain water, making them vital for mitigating climate change.

7. Grasses and Climate Regulation

Grasslands play a major role in carbon cycling. Their roots store large amounts of carbon underground. When left undisturbed, grasslands can act as carbon sinks, helping offset greenhouse gas emissions. Additionally, their albedo (reflectivity) helps regulate Earth's temperature.

8. Cultural Significance of Grass

Grass has been symbolic across various cultures:

In Japan, lawns and moss gardens reflect simplicity and harmony.

In the West, a well-kept lawn is a symbol of domestic pride.

Grasses like bamboo hold spiritual value in many Asian traditions.

9. Grass in Sports and Recreation

From golf courses to football fields, grass is essential in recreational spaces. Turf management has become a specialized field involving biology, chemistry, and engineering to ensure optimal play conditions and aesthetic value.

10. Challenges to Grasslands

Grasslands face threats from:

Overgrazing

Urbanization

Agricultural expansion

Invasive species

Climate change

Conservation efforts focus on sustainable grazing, habitat restoration, and legal protection.

11. Technological Advances in Grass Cultivation

Genetic modification and selective breeding are being used to develop drought-resistant and nutrient-rich grasses. Remote sensing technology helps monitor grassland health on a large scale.

12. The Future of Grasslands

As we face a warming climate, restoring and protecting grasslands becomes critical. They offer potential solutions for sustainable agriculture, carbon sequestration, and biodiversity conservation.

Conclusion

Hey Uzoth! I have a sword idea. (Lvl 1667 at the time of writing this, trying to get electric claw, then i'm getting dragon talon bc it's amazing)
The sword would be called the Tetra Axe, a special axe forged from the shark kind, for the shark kind. It is a special sword with these requirements:
· Unlocked Beast Hunter Ship
· Has shark v4 (equipped)
· A fruit worth $960,000 or higher equipped
· Completing the "Sea Beast Hunter" quest
· Sharkman Karate at max mastery (600)
The Axe's two moves are:
· Electric Splash (200 Mastery) (Stuns) (Burning Damage)
· Deadly Hallowing (450 Mastery) (Stuns)
· The M1 can be the developers idea, but i'd like if it had an effect similar to the fighting style Electric Claw.
To do the Sea Beast Hunter quest, you must talk to "Diagrock the Elder" who is found on Treasure Island (Desert)
Diagrock the Elder's dialogue goes like this:
"Help me, I've been stranded here for 6 years!"
The player can respond with these 2 things:
· "Okay, how can I help?"
· "No thanks."
If the player answers with "No thanks." there is no further dialogue, and the player must find another Treasure Island to talk to him again.
If the player answers with "Okay, how can I help?" Diagrock the Elder will say "Give this note to my son, and while you're at it, defeat 1 sea beast!"
The player now has a quest on the side of their screen (just like any other) that says "Defeat 1 Sea Beast" "Reward: 50,000,000 Exp, $10,000" and they will be given a note in their inventory.
The player must now defeat one sea beast, and deliver the note to "Diagrock; The Sharkman".
After defeating the sea beast and delivering the note, Diagrock: The Sharkman will say "Thank you for this note, I've been trying to contact my father for years! Take this Axe as a token of my appreciation." and you will be rewarded with these things:
· Tetra Axe
· $100,000 
· 1,000 Fragments
· "Ultimate Sharkman" title
At the blacksmith, you can upgrade the axe for 1 Terror Eyes, 1 Rumbling Crystal (obtained with a 5% chance from entering rumbling waters) 20 Mystic Droplets, and 15 Fish Tails.
That's the sword idea! Anyone who read this all, thanks for actually being interested in it.
Also two things I forgot to add, you only need shark v4 equipped to obtain it, not to use it/upgrade it, and the axe is blue/grey with an electric effect.
Edit: the "Ultimate Sharkman" title has a blue title color, a bit lighter than the "Raging Demon" title.

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (115g) unsalted butter
- 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/3 cup (40g) unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup (65g) all-purpose flour
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon baking powder

Optional add-ins:
- 1/2 cup (90g) chocolate chips
- 1/4 cup (30g) chopped nuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x9 inch baking pan or line it with parchment paper.
2. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over low heat.
3. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
4. Beat in cocoa, flour, salt, and baking powder. Spread the batter into the prepared pan.
5. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Do not overcook; the brownies should be soft in the center.
6. Let them cool in the pan before slicing into squares.

My PvP tips:

-Adjust your build to your 
Maybe leopard is not good for you. You should chose the correct fruit depending on your playstyle. If you're a bounty hunter, you shouldn't be using ice or dark if it doesn't match your playstyle as ice and dark strongly depend on oneshot combos, if you're oponent air camps or knows how to kentrick your combos would be just a waste of time.
If your playstyle is agressive, than you should use a close combat fruit like rubber/rumble/ (ice/dark)/venom/gravity...
If your playstyle is passive, meaning that you want to get much distance between you and your oponent, you should use a longrange fruit like light/spider/paw/dragon...
If your playstyle is just spamming then you could use magma/control/venom/dragon/ leopard…
-Do not depend too much on oneshot combos
Most of players depend on a single oneshot combo. If your oponent knows your combo they could time their attack or kentrick to break your combo. You must adapt your combo depending on your oponent. If your oponent lags, land the moves sooner or later.
If your oponent is a bit far from you, use a longrange move like soul guitar z/kabucha x/ buddy sword..

-Stop spamming, learn to combo
Most of players use spam fruit without having aim. I'm not saying that spamming is bad but you should consider hitting the moves rather than spamming. Spamming could also make you invent new combos. Instead of just tapping random keys of the keyboard, you should learn which moves connect after which moves. For example sharkman z connects after sharkman x / god human c connects after god human z / venom f connects after venom z and etc... You should try to hit most of your moves instead of just blindly spamming
- Learn to kentrick
Kentrick is a strong weapon agaisnt oneshot combers. To kentrick you must first disable your ken during a fight. When your oponent uses a move that can be kentricked (control c/ superhuman z/venom z...) quickly enable ken.
If your oponent uses a fruit that can kenbreak you should disable your ken all of the time unless they are using a move that can be kentricked

- Learn to deal agaisnt teamers
If you get teamed on, you should team with your friend to balance the fight. But if you don't have a friend here's some advices that can help you defeat teamers. 1: Target 1 person , you must kill him before the other person. If you try to kill they both at the same time, one will run and heal while the other will buy time.
2:Do not use moves that stuns you in place for a long amout of time like spider v2 C/dragon C/dark x,c. While you attack one player, the others will attack you while your stunned. 3:Do not be scared to run. Mobility is very important in team fights because the players do not have the same speed. You can run and recover some health while they chase you.
-Choose wisely your oponent
Most bounty hunters hunt blinbly without knowing their oponents. 1: Know about bounty buff. For every 500k bounty you have, your attack and defense will rise. So if your oponent's bounty is in the 500k (2.5mil/3mil/ 3.5mil...) your chances of victory might lower drastically. 2:Do not go for people that have friends. You will most likely get teamed on.
3:Know every fruit's weakness. Knowledge is the strongest weapon. If you don't know the pros and cons of a fruit, it could backfire at you. 4: Know your oponent's playstyle. If your oponent aircamps you should use a fruit that can counter that. If your oponent plays agressive you can play passive or passive agressive. If your oponent spams, play passive. If you do not find a good oponent for you, you can always serverhop
-And last but not least, do not be toxic
Games are supposed to be for fun and should not be for frustation. Its okay to lose , do not be frustrated about losing. No matter how toxic your oponent is, you should always spread happiness around you and always say "gg" not "ez" after winning or losing

Cool, but anyway here’s a brownie recipe!

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (225g) unsalted butter
- 2 1/4 cups (450g) granulated sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 1 1/4 cups (150g) unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup (125g) all-purpose flour

Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan or microwave, then stir in the sugar until well combined.
3. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and then add them to the butter and sugar mixture. Stir in the vanilla extract.
4. Sift the cocoa powder, salt, and flour together, then gradually add this dry mixture to the wet ingredients until well combined.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and spread it out evenly.
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
7. Allow the brownies to cool before cutting into squares.

Enjoy your homemade brownies!

Hey Uzoth, hopefully this comes to you in good faith.

I have been playing Blox Fruits for about 2 years now, I have seen a lot of people come and go over this time, gotten to 30m bounty, max lvl, every item yada yada yada. Overall, I would say my opinion reflects a good chunk of the player base seeing as I probably have a few thousand hours in the game.
Note: I have not finished watching the video as I write this so I may make edits as I go on! 

Some things I really hope the game improves on is this outdated UI, which I remember the twitter posts long ago about it but I hope all the things like the map reworks, UI, and remodels are all improved. I also hope other fruits are more viable and that there are more ways to find fruits! I also would like to add that guns should be more viable, while they are amazing they lack damage and speed/size. Something about swords and some of the fruits is that they just have huge ranges making it more fun and fit the dynamic speed and movement of this game. Overall, the game is amazing and even now I still play it! 

However, while this game is doing well, I got some suggestions.

Within blox fruits, there is a need for a PVP balancing update. This can allow more players to enjoy blox fruits, giving them something to grind towards, and help the overall game


In this game, Wwhat I think are needed most: 


Fruit Nerfs:  


Regarding fruits, all the fruits need a damage nerf, all of them, not just leo and kitsune, but light and flame too(all fruits).  This being said, although all fruits need damage nerf, I would give other nerfs to fruits. Additionally, they do more that enough damage needed to kill players, since fighting styles are used to combo extend, you do way too much damage


An example would be leopard. Although contrary to others, I believe  leopard is a balanced fruit. Although many of the moves do insane damage along with low cooldowns, they can be kentricked. With kitsune, you do leopard damage, with extreme speed. Avoiding the fact that the “C” move is a fast ken break stun that does nearly half your HP. Overall, kitsune is basically leopard with Ken breaks & more speed buffs. Thus I would nerf kitsune’s damage slightly, (its still a mythic) and reduce the Speed buff, by like half, (SLIGHT hitbox BUFF can be given)


 Overall, in this game ALL FRUITS need to be nerfed in damage. Not mythics, but all. Besides the nerf with damage, I would also give a ken break to some of the lower tier fruits like light. This would make fruit stats less powerful, but still strong to fight against.




Swords:


Swords are generally more balanced than fruits since they generally do less damage, but they do just enough to one shot a player. This is especially prevalent with CDK and Saber if you see people using it correctly. Although,  since swords are considered to be faster than fruits but have less damage, I would add at least 1 kenbreak to the swords. Shisui x should ken break, Cavender z should kenbreak, and saber deadly rush. Furthermore, I believe swords should get a buff in damage and cooldown decrease, but in turn give a smaller hitbox. This isn’t very notable with some swords. Shown with the entire Shisui moveset, and CDK x, since the hitboxes are close to the size of a player. Enzymes play a vital role in digestion, as they are biological catalysts that speed up the breakdown of large food molecules into smaller, absorbable components. The process of digestion involves several different enzymes, each specialized in breaking down specific types of nutrients, such as carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. The activity of these enzymes is highly dependent on the pH and temperature conditions in the digestive system. Let's explore this dependence in more detail:

1. Role of enzymes in digestion:
Enzymes facilitate the hydrolysis of complex molecules into simpler ones through a process known as catabolism. This breakdown allows the body to absorb essential nutrients effectively. Here are some key digestive enzymes and their roles:

a. Amylase: Found in saliva and pancreatic secretions, amylase breaks down carbohydrates (starches and sugars) into smaller sugar units like maltose and glucose.

b. Proteases: Pepsin in the stomach and various proteases from the pancreas break down proteins into smaller peptides and amino acids.

c. Lipases: Lipases, produced by the pancreas and small intestine, break down fats (lipids) into fatty acids and glycerol.

2. Dependence on pH:

a. Salivary enzymes: The enzymes in the mouth, such as salivary amylase, prefer a slightly acidic to neutral pH. The oral cavity maintains a pH close to neutral (around 6.7 to 7.0), which is optimal for salivary amylase to initiate carbohydrate digestion.

b. Gastric enzymes: Pepsin, the main enzyme in the stomach, requires a highly acidic environment (pH around 1.5 to 2.5) to be active. The stomach secretes hydrochloric acid, creating this low pH condition, which enables pepsin to break down proteins.

c. Pancreatic enzymes: The pancreas secretes a mix of digestive enzymes, including proteases, amylase, and lipase, into the small intestine. These enzymes function best at a slightly alkaline pH (around 7.5 to 8.5), which is achieved by the presence of bile from the liver and bicarbonate ions from the pancreas. This alkaline environment is essential to neutralize the acidic chyme (partially digested food) from the stomach and to enable the pancreatic enzymes to carry out their digestion functions effectively.

3. Dependence on temperature:

Enzymes are sensitive to temperature changes, and their activity is influenced by temperature up to a certain point. The rate of enzymatic reactions generally increases with rising temperature until it reaches an optimal temperature. Beyond this point, high temperatures can cause the enzyme's structure to denature, leading to a loss of activity. The optimal temperature for enzyme activity varies for different enzymes:

a. Most digestive enzymes in the human body function optimally at the body's core temperature, around 37°C (98.6°F).

b. Extreme temperatures, either too hot or too cold, can disrupt the activity of enzymes, potentially affecting the efficiency of digestion.

In summary, enzymes are essential for digestion as they facilitate the breakdown of complex food molecules into simpler nutrients that the body can absorb. The activity of these enzymes is highly dependent on the pH conditions in different parts of the digestive system and the optimal body temperature, ensuring effective digestion and nutrient absorption.
